story.title: FP8 E4M3 vs E5M2 KV-Cache Quantization Tradeoffs
story.summary: Engineers evaluated FP8 mixed-precision on NVIDIA Hopper, finding E4M3 preserves 99.4% accuracy for attention logits while E5M2 prevents exponent overflow in long-context decoding beyond 64k tokens.

story.title: Speculative Decoding with Draft-Model Tree Verification
story.summary: Research demonstrates a tree-based speculative decoding algorithm where a 1.5B draft model proposes 5 token branches verified in a single forward pass by a 70B target model, achieving 2.4x mean speedup.

story.title: Lossless Load Balancing for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
story.summary: A new auxiliary routing loss enforces uniform expert allocation across 16 active sub-networks without token dropping, increasing throughput by 28% on distributed triton clusters.

story.title: Hybrid Dense-Sparse Retrieval with ColBERT Reranking
story.summary: Implementing BM25 reciprocal rank fusion alongside dense cosine similarity and a late-interaction ColBERT cross-encoder reduced Recall@10 search latency by 45ms while improving MRR@10 from 0.72 to 0.89.

story.title: Optimizing SIMDgroup Matrix Multiplication in Apple MLX
story.summary: Apple engineers implemented custom Metal simdgroup_matrix instructions for half-precision GEMM on M3 and M4 Max unified memory architectures, outperforming standard Accelerate BLAS routines by 35%.

story.title: Direct Preference Optimization at Scale Without Reference Models
story.summary: A breakthrough formulation eliminates the reference policy forward pass during DPO training, reducing VRAM footprint by 42% on 8x H100 clusters while matching standard RLHF win rates on AlpacaEval 2.0.
